var inputData = `°·*.☆ 全部榜单 ☆.*·°

武侠小说::/wuxia/{{page}}.html
体育小说::/tiyu/{{page}}.html
言情小说::/yanqing/{{page}}.html`;
var categories = [];
var lines = inputData.split('\n').filter(l => l.trim());
var items = [];
for(var i=0;i<lines.length;i++){ var parts=lines[i].split('::');var title=parts[0]||'';var url=(parts[1]||'').trim();if(!url){categories.push({title:title,url:'',style:{layout_flexGrow:1,layout_flexBasisPercent:1}});}else{items.push({title:title,url:url,style:{layout_flexGrow:1,layout_flexBasisPercent:0.25}});}}
for(var j=0;j<items.length;j++)categories.push(items[j]);
JSON.stringify(categories);
